messages.author: Shiho Ohno
messages.body:
Dear Amber Administrator
Please excuse me for asking this question.
My name is Sasaki, Tohoku Medical and Pharmaceutical University.
I have a question about Amber, so I would like to contact you.
Q. I am currently trying to install Amber18 and AmberTools21, but it does
not work. Do you have an installation manual?
Q. I thought it might be due to the fact that the versions of Amber and
Tools do not match, so I looked for Tools18 on the Internet, but I could not
find it. Where can I find the Tools18 file?
Current situation: AmberTools21 was supposed to be installed using cmake,
but this method failed.
I would appreciate your answer.
Thank you very much for your time.
Tohoku Medical and Pharmaceutical University Sasaki

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Jul 15, 2021, Shiho Ohno wrote:
>
>Q. I am currently trying to install Amber18 and AmberTools21, but it does
>not work. Do you have an installation manual?
Amber18 needs to be paired with AmberTools19, which is available here:
https://ambermd.org/downloads/AmberTools19.tar.bz2
Use the Amber 2019 Reference Manual for installation, available here:
https://ambermd.org/Manuals.php
>Current situation: AmberTools21 was supposed to be installed using cmake,
>but this method failed.
You would need to say what you tried, and what the result was.  Otherwise,
just saying "this method failed" doesn't provide enough information for
anyone to be of much help.
....dac
